mechanistic_edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-7915
mechanistic_edges.description: Native MetaCyc complex model has four PraA subunits. Historical native enzyme was reported tetrameric, but its 35.5-kDa subunit estimate differs from the 266-aa recombinant sequence; this does not establish exact sequence identity of the historical preparation or measure oligomerization of the 2009 recombinant construct.

evidence.source_assertion: The native complex component is MONOMER-15106 with coefficient4.
MONOMER-15106 is explicitly unified to UniProt C4TP01.

mechanistic_edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-7915
mechanistic_edges.description: Fe2+ is a source-supported cofactor of the historical native protocatechuate 2,3-dioxygenase, reported at one atom per subunit. The native database associates this property with CPLX-7915; the 2009 recombinant assembly and its metal occupancy were not measured by this evidence.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-16910 lists FE+2 as a cofactor, cites PMID8392511, and identifies CPLX-7915 as its enzyme.
The native annotation reports Fe2+ dependence and one iron atom per monomer, citing the 1993 characterization.

mechanistic_edges.subject: CHEBI:64755
mechanistic_edges.description: Native database assertion of an in-vitro inhibitor of the purified-enzyme activity, citing Wolgel and Lipscomb1990. Concentration and inhibition mechanism are not given in the structured object; no physiological regulatory role or metal requirement is inferred. Chemical ionization follows the source-normalized compound, not measured assay protonation.

evidence.source_assertion: The native regulation object assigns mode minus to EDTA acting on ENZRXN-16910/CPLX-7915; its citation is PMID2280722 and mechanism is OTHER.

mechanistic_edges.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-7915
mechanistic_edges.description: The native database model assigns protocatechuate 2,3-cleavage activity to CPLX-7915 with native-host purified-protein evidence from 1990/1993. This is the curated historical enzyme assignment; it does not directly establish that the historical 35.5-kDa subunit preparation had the complete 2009 C4TP01 sequence or that the recombinant construct had the same assembly.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-16910 assigns CPLX-7915 to RXN-10882. Separate EV-EXP-IDA-PURIFIED-PROTEIN-NH evidence cites PMID2280722 and PMID8392511; the 2009 heterologous assay is not the basis of this native-preparation claim.
The complete native enzymatic-reaction object assigns CPLX-7915 to RXN-10882. Heterologous-assay evidence includes PMID19717587; primary construct details must remain on affected assay endpoints.
